text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High GPU queue length detected in gcp-europe-west2. Autoscaler failing to attach GPUs due to quota errors. Queue size ~2.3k, token/sec spike. Triggered 2024-10-12T09:12Z :rotating_light:

oncall-sre (Ben): taking this. Seen increased 5xx and timeouts on inference routes. Will start triage now.

benjamin: control-plane logs show repeated errors: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Quota 'accelerators' exceeded for project redwood-prod (zone europe-west2)". Sample attach failure: `AttachAcceleratorOperation: quotaExceeded`.

irene: tagging cloud-ops and infra. @cloud-ops can you confirm current quota and any ETA on bump? We need options.

cloud-ops: Investigating. Current GPU quota usage europe-west2: total quota 16, in-use 16, free 0. We filed quota increase Q-7783 at 2024-10-12T09:18Z. GCP estimate currently 4-6h for non-urgent increases. Trying to request an emergency review.

maria (prod-eng): Immediate mitigations we should do: 1) reroute new requests to eu-west1/us-west2 pools, 2) enable quantized model fallback for high-throughput customers, 3) shift some traffic to Dedicated reserved capacity if possible.

oncall-sre (Ben): I'll enable reroute and soft-fallback now. Patching routing config: 
```
kubectl patch configmap redwood-routing -n prod --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/primary_region","value":"eu-west1"}]'
```

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook step 3 executed by Ben: routing pref change applied. Expected latency delta ~+30-50ms for affected requests.

benjamin: Also rolled out quantized model v1.2 as a soft-fallback on the inference tier for batched workloads. Watch evals for quality regressions.

irene: Customer impact summary so far: high-throughput customers (cust_41, cust_109) seeing 5-10% elevated error rate and longer tail latency. CS notified to prep comms.

maria: Spinning up temporary routing to Dedicated (aws-eu-west reserved pool) to absorb some load — creating token-route rule to send 20% of overflow.

oncall-sre (Ben): Temporary route created and applied. Monitoring queue now: 2300 -> 900 and continuing down. CPU/GPU attach errors decreased after reroute.

cloud-ops: Update: GCP approved emergency bump for preemptible GPUs to 8 within ~45m. Permanent quota for non-preemptible still pending.

benjamin: Operational plan: keep reroute + quantized fallback + dedicated routing until preemptible GPUs online and attach stabilized. If non-preemptible quota not renewed within 6h escalate to SEV2.

maria: I'll take follow-up shift at ~09:45Z. Will own customer comms, canary checks, and metric thresholds for auto-rollback. @irene please handoff any remaining items.

irene: Handoff noted. Please post short incident summary when stabilized and link runbook. If queue >500 after 60m, escalate.

oncall-sre (Ben): Acknowledged. Posting status updates every 10m. :thumbsup:
